create_AgentConfig: create an AgentConfig with provider, model, temperature, and max_tokens settings for LLM agent configuration
build_create_client: build an OpenAI-compatible API client from an AgentConfig with provider base URL and API key
run_call_llm_simple: run a simple one-shot LLM call with a system prompt and user message using the configured provider
run_BaseAgent_run: run a BaseAgent subclass with tool registration, message history, and iteration-based LLM tool loop
summarize_dialog_to_text: summarize a dialog history list into plain text with role labels for analysis and debugging
